bead.title: bench-pr-A4: concurrency (flock/setsid/--jobs), signal handling, and budget halting
bead.description:
PROBLEM: A bash sweep must safely run cells in parallel, survive SIGINT/SIGTERM without orphaning Docker containers or leaving half-owned state, and stop before exceeding a cost cap.

ROOT CAUSE: The A3 runner core executes cells but has no concurrency control, no signal trap, no in-flight accounting, and no budget accumulator; the legacy Go runner's equivalents in cmd/bench/matrix.go are being retired.

PROPOSED FIX (extends scripts/benchmark/benchmark):
- Concurrency: flock per concurrency-group at ${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/fizeau-benchmark}/locks/<group>.lock; setsid for each cell process group; background-job pool capped by --jobs.
- Signals: trap SIGINT/SIGTERM -> stop accepting new cells; SIGTERM each in-flight cell's process group and `docker stop` each in-flight harbor-runner container; wait 30s then SIGKILL; write final_status=interrupted (process_outcome=killed, no metrics) to in-flight cells; exit non-zero.
- In-flight state: ${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}/<hostname>/in-flight.json; under flock append this cell at start, read current count into the cell, remove at close; prune stale entries (dead PID) at next read.
- Budget: compute cost_usd_at_run_time per cell from profile.pricing × token streams at close; accumulate into <out>/budget.json; halt before the next cell when the cap is hit; skipped cells get final_status=budget_halted placeholder with process_outcome=setup_failed and a 'note' field.

NON-SCOPE: runner dispatch/matrix/--plan/execution loop (A3, prerequisite); harbor image (A1); shell adapters (A2); Go agent-leak fix, parity, deactivation (A5); plus parent out-of-scope: cell-report.schema.json (PR B), tasks_from/task_executor schema (PR C), Node collector (PR D), Node importers (PR E), deleting cmd/bench (PR F), docs (PR G).

GOVERNING ARTIFACT: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDENCIES: A3 (runner core + per-cell loop). Satisfies parent AC3 and AC5.

ACCEPTANCE (numbered; Test* symbols in scripts/benchmark/tests/concurrency.bats):
1. Test_budget_halt_produces_budget_halted: `./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary --max-cost-usd 0.01` produces at least one cell with final_status=budget_halted (parent AC3).
2. Test_sigterm_marks_interrupted: SIGTERM to a mid-sweep run marks in-flight cells final_status=interrupted (process_outcome=killed) (parent AC5).
3. Test_sigterm_docker_stops_containers: SIGTERM `docker stop`s each in-flight harbor-runner container (parent AC5).
4. Test_sigterm_exit_nonzero: the interrupted run exits non-zero (parent AC5), verified by `./benchmark ... & sleep 5; kill -TERM $!; wait; jq .final_status bench/results/.../report.json`.
5. Test_concurrency_flock_serializes_group: two cells in the same concurrency-group never hold the group lock simultaneously, and in-flight.json prunes dead-PID entries.
Gates: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes (shellcheck + bats); `go test ./...` passes.
bead.acceptance: Test_budget_halt_produces_budget_halted, Test_sigterm_marks_interrupted, Test_sigterm_docker_stops_containers, Test_sigterm_exit_nonzero, and Test_concurrency_flock_serializes_group pass; lefthook pre-commit and go test ./... pass.
